name: Secondary bonding application; rigid composites part; at plant
description: Secondary bonding should not be confused with secondary lamination, which is a different process, as it uses more bond material and can be much more energy intensive. Complete inventory data and metadata are shown in full in the final report, Life Cycle Inventory of Polymer Composites.  The report is not publicly available. This report has been extensively reviewed within Franklin Associates by Rebe Feraldi, Anne Marie Molen, and Melissa Huff and has undergone partial critical review by ACMA members. Important note: although most of the data in the US LCI database has undergone some sort of review, the database as a whole has not yet undergone a formal validation process.  Please email comments to lci@nrel.gov.

processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Application of adhesive material to bond two rigid composite parts.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Data are from primary sources. The composites fabricators who provided data for this module verified that the characteristics of their plants are representative of North American composites fabrication facilities providing secondary bonding of composite parts. The representativeness of the composites fabrication processes are unknown, but estimated to be less than 10% of the US production volume.
processDocumentation.restrictionsDescription: All information can be accessed by everybody.
